title: nirs4all explanation envelope v1
description: Host-built envelope around one attribution result (nirs4all-methods AttributionResult or the python shap package) plus host metadata. Arrays are indexed [row][group][output] (attributions, std_error) and [row][output] (expected_value, prediction). Explained-row indices and source-partition indices (rows.sample_indices) are never interchanged. Consumers ignore unknown keys.

kind.description: Explainer that produced the attributions (gradient: ABI 2.24 local finite-difference gradient times (x - background mean), not additive).

name.description: nirs4all-methods for the native kernels; python-shap when the SDK default shap backend produced the values.

abi.description: nirs4all-methods C ABI version (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH); null or absent for other engines.

additive.description: True when sum over groups of attributions plus expected_value equals prediction for every row and output.

group_aggregation.description: group_game: groups are players of the coalition game; sum_of_feature_values: per-feature values summed within groups (TreeSHAP); none: one group per feature.

attribution_space.description: raw_input: the complete fitted pipeline was explained in its raw input space; transformed_features: the terminal estimator was explained after preprocessing.

values.description: One numeric axis coordinate per feature of the explained space.

unit.description: Axis unit as recorded by the host (for example nm or cm-1); null when unknown. Never invented.

groups.description: One entry per attribution group, in attribution order.

sample_indices.description: sample_indices[i] is the source-partition index of explained row i; null when the host has no source mapping.

std_error.description: Monte-Carlo standard errors (permutation SHAP) with the attributions shape; null otherwise. Individual entries may be null (single draw).

additivity_max_abs_error.description: max |sum(attributions) + expected_value - prediction| over rows and outputs; null when the explainer is not additive.

settings.description: Explainer settings (baseline, n_background, n_permutations, n_coalitions, seed, ...).
